cohort: 10 women with a pregnancy implanted in or on a Cesarean section scar in the first trimester (<12 weeks' gestation)
finding: Implantation of a pregnancy on or in a Cesarean section scar in the first trimester is a precursor of morbidly adherent placenta (MAP), with the severity varying and being difficult to predict based on first-trimester ultrasound findings alone.
gest_age: <12 weeks at study entry, ranging from 26 to 38 weeks at delivery
